Mew GG10: check Crown Zenith GG10/GG70 before pricing

2026-11-05

The search name Mew GG10 refers here to the English Crown Zenith: Galarian Gallery Mew numbered GG10/GG70. The GG prefix and full number matter. Mewtwo VSTAR GG44/GG70 is a different Pokemon and a different card, even though both results can appear in a search for Mew.

The second row is an identity comparison, not an alternative price for Mew GG10. Neither sample specifies raw condition or slab grade. They are dated published references, not individual completed sales, offers or guaranteed resale values.

What to confirm on the physical card

Read the name Mew and the complete GG10/GG70 number. Match the artwork, English language and finish to the selected record. A different language, gallery number or Mew printing needs its own reference. Keep a photo or seller title as a clue until those details agree.

If your card is in a slab, use the grading company and grade printed on its label. A raw card does not acquire a PSA 10 value because the artwork looks clean in a photo. Review raw versus graded card values before comparing the two markets.

Check a Mew GG10 price in Card AI

Search for Mew GG10, Crown Zenith or GG10/GG70 in the app, or start with the Pokemon card scanner. Review the candidate and confirm the printing, finish and language. Choose your copy's raw condition or existing slab grade, then open its available price and history in the card price checker.

Keep an unavailable price as unavailable. Do not use Mewtwo's value or a sample from another date to fill the gap. If you own several copies with different conditions or grades, keep those holdings distinct in the collection tracker.

Browse Pokemon card values by name and number for other characters. This page identifies one Mew printing; it is not a complete Mew price list or a live web valuation tool.
